interpretation: Synthetic batch timings. Within each round, baseline means the original fixture and candidate means that round's production helper. Ratios are original/candidate, with seven alternating pairs; below one is a regression. Paired ratio medians need not equal ratios of timing medians. Separate rounds are not interleaved comparisons of old and new helpers: do not divide their ratios or timings to claim an improvement. The conveyor and power emitters compare both outputs before printing one shared checksum; this parser checks its consistency across all pairs and matching rounds. These fixtures do not measure Unity/Mono, GPU upload, workload frequency or game FPS.
